basic_details.job_title: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines), Dhanbad (IIT (ISM) Dhanbad) has notified 1 vacancy for the Project Assistant post on a project-based tenure of 1.5 years or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier. The advertised pay for the post is 27,000 per month. Candidates applying for the post must possess a Bachelor's degree in Science (PCM)/3 years Diploma in Electronics Engineering or higher degree. content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines), Dhanbad
Capacity building for human resource development in Unmanned Aircraft System (Drone and related Technology)
1.5 years or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier
Maximum 25 years at the date of joining with suitable age relaxations applicable for reserved candidates as per GOI norms

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Additional Essential Knowledge and Skills: The candidates must have a good academic background and knowledge/skills in one or more of the following areas: Electronics and electronic circuits, embedded systems, microcontrollers, sensors and instrumentation, programming, UAV/drone technology, circuit assembly and testing and hardware troubleshooting. Desirable Qualification: Experience in drone technologies Good communication skills

rows.essential_qualification_required: Bachelor's degree in Science (PCM)/3 years Diploma in Electronics Engineering or higher degree

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Fill out the online application using the official application link. Attach all supporting documents, including self-attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificate, Aadhar card, age proof, and CV with photo. Submit the completed online application on or before 20th Oct, 2026 until 11:59 pm.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed through email about the interview. The interview would be conducted in online or offline mode. The date and time of the interview will be sent to the shortlisted candidates by email. Mere possession of the minimum qualifications does not guarantee an invitation to the interview, as candidates will be shortlisted based on their merits and the requirements of the project.

faq.question: Q1. What is the upper age limit for the Project Assistant post and are there relaxations?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 25 years at the date of joining, with suitable age relaxations applicable for reserved candidates as per GOI norms.

faq.question: Q2. How will candidates be shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merits and as per the requirements of the project. Mere possession of the minimum qualifications does not guarantee an invitation to the interview.

faq.question: Q3. Where will shortlisted candidates be informed about the interview details?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed through email about the interview, including the online or offline mode, date, and time.

faq.question: Q4. What are the desirable qualifications mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The desirable qualifications are experience in drone technologies and good communication skills.

faq.question: Q5. What documents are required to be attached with the online application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach all supporting documents, such as self-attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificate, Aadhar card, age proof, and CV with photo.
